items.title: Collect Gold Bullion
items.detail: Purchase from Smiley at The Wayward for 1,000 caps per 50 bullion

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any decoration from the Decorations category in build menu

items.title: Catch a Fish in the Toxic Valley Region
items.detail: Fish at any water source in Toxic Valley, such as Graninger Farm's toxic pools

items.title: Complete an Event or Activity
items.detail: Join any public event or activity available on the map

items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Head
items.detail: West Tek Research Center has dense Super Mutant spawns

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Skyline Valley Region
items.detail: Grindstone Arch at the western edge has dense Super Mutant populations

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Bone
items.detail: Craft Bulk Bone Shards at a Tinker's Workbench then scrap them

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Found at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Join or start a Daily Ops public team and complete the operation

items.title: Craft any Plushie at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Build a Tinkerer's Bench at C.A.M.P. or use the one at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Spooky Scorched appear during the seasonal event; try Morgantown Airport

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station at a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Orange
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station at a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Whitespring Golf Club has dense Feral Ghoul populations

items.title: Kill a Creature while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume item and kill creatures at Poseidon Energy Plant

items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Obtain from Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine at any C.A.M.P.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Spooky Scorched enemies with Halloween costumes and exclusive rewards including mystery candy and legendary drops.

events.name: Minerva (List 7)
events.description: Weekend vendor rotation offering plans including Gauss weapons, Brotherhood recon armor, and other craftable items.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Double rewards for challenge completion and increased caps drops from enemies and looting.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Community celebration event with special rewards and activities.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Major vendor sale event offering discounted gold bullion prices on various plans.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Daily Operations event with double mutations and increased legendary rewards.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with special mutations for enhanced difficulty and rewards.
